beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: An island group in the South Pacific known for its scuba diving, luxury resorts, and crystal-clear turquoise lagoons.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: One of the most famous beaches in the world, located in Rio de Janeiro, featuring vibrant culture and stunning views.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: A massive Buddhist temple complex in Cambodia and a UNESCO World Heritage site admired for its grand architecture.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An iconic ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna, showcasing exquisite Mughal design.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A bustling metropolis blending ultra-modern technology with traditional temples and neon-lit skyscrapers.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Famous for its classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Famous for its sprawling Copacabana and Ipanema beaches, towering Christ the Redeemer statue, and lively spirit.

cities.name: Sao Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: A massive cultural financial hub known for its strong economic presence, architecture, and diverse dining scene.
